Same schema as the cleude and flow-mind script.json, plus optional keys the composer ignores until the tweaks of PLAN.md section 4.5 are applied: lines[].hold (seconds of digest pause after a line) and lines[].zoomHint (the UI region to focus). step numbers are the scene() numbers of the demo specs listed in PLAN.md section 4.

parts.title: Opening an account is more than a form
parts.subtitle: An identity check, a signature, a person who decides
parts.say: Opening an account is more than a form. There is an identity check, a signature, and a person who decides.

lines.say: Staff onboard each new institution into its own workspace, from one console.
lines.zoomHint: Dialog fields: the three inputs show how little it takes

lines.text: Verify and sign on a phone
lines.say: Customers verify their identity and sign from their phone.
lines.zoomHint: Phone frame, centred bezel; caption column right

lines.text: A person decides, with a reason
lines.say: When a check is inconclusive, a reviewer decides and has to give a reason.

lines.text: Automatic when the case is clear
lines.say: Clear-cut cases are decided automatically.
Large decisions can require two different senior approvers.
And every action lands in an append-only, tamper-evident audit trail.

lines.say: El personal incorpora cada institución nueva en su propio espacio de trabajo, desde una sola consola.
